author: rsi_demo
title: G37 · 拒绝
body: Generation 37 changes only matMul, replacing its exact-input 2×2 FMA tile with a register-sized 3×3 FMA tile while preserving the transposed-B layout, increasing-k operation order, exact fallback behavior, and dense Float64Array output. The new tile reduces tile count, input loads, and loop overhead while exposing enough independent accumulators to hide FMA latency; a projected 1.65× matrix gain would raise the aggregate from 54.25× to about 57.8×, above the 56.96× acceptance threshold.
